						,ISNULL(B.MEA_VALUE, A.MEA_VALUE) MEA_VALUE
						,ISNULL(B.TYPE, A.TYPE) TYPE
						,ISNULL(B.FLAG, A.FLAG) FLAG
						,A.MENU_ID

			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			    SELECT *
			    FROM   TH_UIS_USER_AMEND_MEA_RELATE B WITH(NOLOCK)

-- TYPE = command---@CTRL_SITE_LT---Check client parameter : CTRL_PLANT_LT

-- TYPE = command---@CTRL_PLANT_LT---Check client parameter : CTRL_FACTORY_LT
---FOUND CTRL_FACTORY_LT
-- TYPE = command---@CTRL_FACTORY_LT
SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION, A.ITEM_ID
     , UPPER(A.CATEGORY) AS CATEGORY
     , A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE, A.VERSION_TYPE
     , A.MODEL_ID, A.VALUE, A.APPLY_DATE
     , A.VERSION
FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN (
	SELECT DISTINCT A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS E_CATEGORY
	FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'ITEM_CONV_CALC'
	AND    A.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
) D
ON     A.CATEGORY = D.E_CATEGORY
INNER JOIN (
	SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
	FROM   SCM_ITEM_CONV_CALC_M A WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE  1=1
	AND    A.VALUE > 0
	AND    A.CATEGORY IN (  'Jumbo Roll (cell/m)'
    						, 'Lane Number'
    						, 'Pancake (m/batch)'
    						, 'cell/batch'
    						, 'Jumbo Roll (m/batch)'
    						, 'Pancake (cell/m)' )
	GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, MODEL_ID, OPERATION, ITEM_ID, VERSION
	HAVING COUNT(1) = 6
) E
ON     A.COMPANY_ID         = E.COMPANY_ID
AND    A.DIVISION_ID        = E.DIVISION_ID
AND    A.SITE_ID            = E.SITE_ID
AND    A.PLANT_ID           = E.PLANT_ID
AND    A.FACTORY_ID         = E.FACTORY_ID
AND    A.OPERATION          = E.OPERATION
AND    A.ITEM_ID            = E.ITEM_ID
AND    A.MODEL_ID           = E.MODEL_ID
AND    A.VERSION            = E.VERSION
WHERE  1=1
AND    A.OPERATION = 'E2000'
AND    A.CATEGORY IN ('cell/batch','Pancake (m/batch)','Jumbo Roll (m/batch)')
AND A.DIVISION_ID  = '81' 
AND A.SITE_ID  = 'A001' 
AND A.PLANT_ID  = 'HQ07' 
AND A.FACTORY_ID  IN ('E5','E6')

             (CASE WHEN MONTH = '01' THEN 'Jan'
                   WHEN MONTH = '02' THEN 'Feb'
                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'
                   WHEN MONTH = '09' THEN 'Sep'
                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
                   WHEN MONTH = '11' THEN 'Nov'
                   ELSE 'Dec' END) AS MONTH_NAME
           , COUNT(*) AS MONTH_COUNT

      WHERE  CAL.DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_FROM, 112)
      AND    CAL.DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @BUCKET_TO, 112)
      GROUP BY YYYYMM, MONTH
      ORDER BY YYYYMM

                   WHEN MONTH = '03' THEN 'Mar'
                   WHEN MONTH = '04' THEN 'Apr'
                   WHEN MONTH = '05' THEN 'May'
                   WHEN MONTH = '06' THEN 'Jun'
                   WHEN MONTH = '07' THEN 'Jul'
                   WHEN MONTH = '08' THEN 'Aug'

                   WHEN MONTH = '10' THEN 'Oct'
